title.narrative: Environmentally-sound development of the power sector with the final disposal of PCBs

description.narrative: ..Environmentally-sound development of the power sector with the final disposal of PCBs. The objective of this project is to assist the power sector of the country in fulfilling its obligations under the Stockholm Convention by reducing the release of PCBs to the environment and disposing of 500tons of PCB-containing equipment, oil, and waste in an environmentally sound manner.
